With reference to the endorsement of Deputy Com-
missioner (Special Branch) on the attached report dated Janu-
ary 30,1935 on the subject of Russian Emigres organizations in
Shanghai and Harbin ( File D-6457),I forward herewith memoranda
containing particulars regarding the " All-Russian Fascist
Party", the " National Union of the New Generation" and the
" Russian Nationalist Party ( Rosnazi)."

The first named organization is known chiefly by
the activities of its Harbin group and by their daily newspaper
entitled " Nash Put". The "National Union of the New Generation"
is an organization of a national-patriotic character and is clo-
sely connected with the "Russian General Military Union",while
the "Rosnazi" do not exist as a political party and present an
interest only inspfaras their program may reflect to a certain
extent the ideas of a part of Russian emigres.

page_data.en:
ALL-RUSSIAN FASCIST PARTY

Endeavours to organize politically active elements
among Russian emigres into a party with a program based on
Fascist principles were first made in November, 1926, when
the so-called "National Organization of Russian Fascisti"
was established in Yugoslavia. In 1927 a declaration was
published by that organization, in which fundamental principles
of its activities were expounded and Russian patriots were
called upon to rally around the banners bearing the three
basic slogans of the Russian Fascisti: "GOD, NATION, LABOUR".
The program of the Russian Fascisti has certain common
features with several other Russian political factions of
post-revolutionary formation, such as "Mladorossy", etc.,
insofar as they have definitely abandoned the idea of
restoration of the pre-revolutionary Russia and strive, by
means of a "national revolution", to overthrow the communist
regime in Russia, after which a "Third Russia" will be built
up on new economic and social foundations.

The Russian Fascisti maintain that the bankruptcy
of both the capitalist and communist forms of organization of
society is evident and therefore advocate the establishment of
a new system, which they describe as "SOLIDARISM" and which is
based on subordination of all personal and class interests to
the interests of the National State. They also declare that
an active minority of Russian national-thinking, truly
democratic citizens, capable of rendering disinterested service
to their country, must be organized beforehand in order to
take the lead after the communist yoke has been overthrown.

Since 1927 groups of Russian Fascisti were formed in
various countries where Russian emigrants reside, including
China. The Harbin group was always one of the strongest numer-
ically and following the Japanese coup d'etat in Manchuria has
gradually become prominent thanks to moral and material support
which, it is reported, the Japanese authorities
accorded to that faction of Russian emigrants.
page_data.zh:
全俄法西斯党

首次尝试将俄罗斯流亡者中的政治活跃分子组织成一个基于法西斯原则的政党是在1926年11月，当时在南斯拉夫成立了所谓的“俄罗斯法西斯民族组织”。1927年，该组织发表了一份宣言，阐述了其活动的基本原则，并呼吁俄罗斯爱国者团结在印有俄罗斯法西斯三大基本口号的旗帜下：“上帝、民族、劳动”。

俄罗斯法西斯分子的纲领与某些其他后革命时期形成的俄罗斯政治派别（如“年轻俄罗斯人”等）有一定的共同特征，因为它们已明确放弃恢复革命前俄罗斯的想法，而是试图通过“民族革命”推翻俄罗斯的共产主义政权，之后将在新的经济和社会基础上建立“第三俄罗斯”。

俄罗斯法西斯分子认为，资本主义和共产主义这两种社会组织形式的破产是显而易见的，因此主张建立一种他们称之为“团结主义”的新制度，该制度基于将所有个人和阶级利益服从于民族国家的利益。他们还宣称，必须事先组织起一部分具有民族思想、真正民主且能够无私为国服务的俄罗斯公民中的积极少数派，以便在推翻共产主义枷锁后发挥领导作用。

自1927年以来，在俄罗斯流亡者居住的各种国家（包括中国）都成立了俄罗斯法西斯分子小组。哈尔滨团体在人数上一直是最强大的之一，并且在日本在满洲发动政变后，由于据称日本当局对该派系的俄罗斯流亡者给予了精神和物质支持，其地位逐渐凸显。

publication was commenced in Harbin of a Fascist organ
entitled "NASH PUT", which has since been conducting a strong
propaganda of the Fascist ideas and violently attacking
communists generally and communist and pro-communist Jewry
in particular. At the same time the newspaper advocates
a close co-operation of Russian patriots with Japan.

In June, 1933, a group of Russian Fascisti in
America under the leadership of A. Vonsiatsky started the
publication of a monthly journal entitled "ALL FASCIST" in
Putnam, Conn., U.S.A. In his "Open letter to the Fascist
Headquarters", which appeared in No. 1 issue of that journal,
Vonsiatsky advocated the urgent necessity of a campaign with
a view to winning the support of the peasants' masses in the
USSR by adopting tactics outlined in the letter in question
and which in his opinion, correspond to the expectations of
the Russian peasantry. In spring of 1934 Vonsiatsky
undertook a round-the-world tour with the purpose of
unification of various separate groups of Russian Fascisti
into one party. While in Japan, he had a conference with a
certain K. Rodzaevsky, representative of the Harbin Fascisti,
during the course of which an agreement was reached between
them regarding the amalgamation of their respective groups
into one party to be known in future as the "All-Russian
Fascist Party".

On April 10, 1934 Vonsiatsky arrived in Shanghai and
after ten days' stay in this city proceeded to Harbin, where
he was welcomed with a great pomp by the local Fascisti. He
was then elected President of the Party, while Rodzaevsky was
appointed Secretary-General of the Party, the Central Executive
Committee of which was established in Harbin. Returning to
Shanghai after three weeks' absence, Vonsiatsky delivered a
lecture on the Russian Fascist Movement at the Embassy Theatre
on May 21 and left for Europe on the following day.

在哈尔滨开始出版一份名为《我们的道路》（NASH PUT）的法西斯刊物，该刊物此后一直大力宣扬法西斯思想，猛烈攻击一般意义上的共产主义者，特别是犹太裔共产主义者和亲共产主义者。同时，该报主张俄罗斯爱国者与日本紧密合作。

1933年6月，在美国的一群俄罗斯法西斯分子在 A. 冯西亚茨基（A. Vonsiatsky）的领导下，开始在美国康涅狄格州普特南（Putnam, Conn.）出版一份名为《全法西斯》（ALL FASCIST）的月刊。在该刊第一期发表的《致法西斯总部公开信》中，冯西亚茨基主张紧急开展一场运动，旨在通过采用该信中概述的战术来赢得苏联农民大众的支持，他认为这些战术符合俄罗斯农民的期望。1934年春，冯西亚茨基进行了一次环球旅行，目的是将各个分散的俄罗斯法西斯分子小组统一为一个政党。在日本期间，他与哈尔滨法西斯分子的代表 K. 罗扎耶夫斯基（K. Rodzaevsky）举行了会议，在此期间，双方就将其各自的小组合并为一个政党达成协议，该党未来将被称为“全俄法西斯党”。

1934年4月10日，冯西亚茨基抵达上海，在该市停留十天后前往哈尔滨，当地法西斯分子以盛大的仪式欢迎他。随后他当选为党主席，而罗扎耶夫斯基被任命为党的总书记，党的中央执行委员会设在哈尔滨。离开三周后回到上海，冯西亚茨基于5月21日在大使剧院（Embassy Theatre）发表了关于俄罗斯法西斯运动的演讲，并于次日前往欧洲。

While in Shanghai, he endeavoured to establish a
branch of the All-Russian Fascist Party here, but the interest,
which his arrival undoubtedly aroused among local Russians,
soon died away owing to the general disappointment in his
personality as a leader, as well as to his haphazard manner of
carrying out his mission. The only practical result of his
visit to Shanghai was the formation of several groups of
Fascist sympathisers who, not being unified into one body,
recognize the Harbin Executive Committee as their centre. With
the exception of holding one or two public lectures their
activity in Shanghai has since been limited to distribution
of the Fascist literature and the "Nash Put", which became
the central organ of the All-Russian Fascist Party.

Towards the end of 1934 an open breach took place
between the Harbin group of the All-Russian Fascist Party and
their newly elected leader A. Vonsiatsky, as a result of which
the latter was expelled from the party. Vonsiatsky's hostile
x 10. 7450 attitude towards Ataman Semenoff, which found its outward
expression in a series of articles published in "The Fascist"
after Vonsiatsky visited Manchuria, is believed to have been
the main point of his difference with the Harbin group. It
hardly can be doubted that the Harbin Fascisti cannot carry
on their activities on a more or less big scale without the
approval of the Japanese authorities in Manchukuo. It is,
therefore, evident that they could ill-afford putting up with
Vonsiatsky's attacks on Ataman Semenoff, whose position with
the Japanese is reported to have been considerably strengthened
recently. To this may be added a feeling of disappointment
in Vonsiatsky, who, being a rich person, was expected to accord
considerable financial support to the party, but failed to do so.

在上海期间，他试图在此建立全俄法西斯党的分支机构，但他的到来无疑在当地俄罗斯人中激起的兴趣很快消退，原因是大家对他作为领导人的个性普遍感到失望，以及他执行任务的方式杂乱无章。他访问上海的唯一实际成果是形成了一些法西斯同情者小组，这些小组没有统一为一个整体，承认哈尔滨执行委员会为其中心。除了举办一两次公开讲座外，他们在上海的活动此后仅限于分发法西斯文献和《我们的道路》（Nash Put），后者已成为全俄法西斯党的中央机关报。

1934年底，全俄法西斯党哈尔滨团体与其新当选的领导人 A. 冯西亚茨基之间发生了公开破裂，结果后者被开除出党。冯西亚茨基对谢苗诺夫阿塔曼（Ataman Semenoff）的敌对态度（这种态度在他访问满洲后发表在《法西斯》杂志上的一系列文章中得到了外在表现）被认为是他与哈尔滨团体分歧的主要点。毫无疑问，如果没有伪满洲国日本当局的批准，哈尔滨法西斯分子无法进行较大规模的活动。因此，显然他们不能容忍冯西亚茨基对谢苗诺夫阿塔曼的攻击，据报道，谢苗诺夫在日本的地位最近大大加强。此外，还可以加上对冯西亚茨基的失望感，他身为富人，人们原本期望他能给予政党大量的财政支持，但他未能做到。

“远东俄罗斯法西斯民族组织”的一个分支名义上自1927年以来存在于上海，其重要性甚至低于全俄法西斯党的当地小组。

page_data.en:
The Russian Branch of the Russian Nationalist Party
( ROSNATI )

During the latter part of 1933 a pamphlet in Russian
entitled "League Of Patriots Appeal To Peoples Of Russia"
purporting to have emanated from the "International League
of Patriots" was circulated among the Russian community in
Shanghai together with another pamphlet containing a brief
outline of the program of the "Russian Nationalist Party"
(Rosnati) ostensibly published by the "Directing Centre"
of the party at Riga. During the course of 1934 a series
of four "declarations" published by the "Far Eastern Branch
of the Russian Nationalist Party (Rosnati)" were circulated
in Shanghai. In these declarations various points of the
party's program were explained in a more detailed manner.

The contents of the "League of Patriots Appeal to
Peoples of Russia", as well as the name of the party, leave
very little room for doubt that the activities of the
promoters of the party were inspired by Nazi's triumphant
coming into power in Germany. The League, of which the
main purpose is "to do away with the exploitation of one
people, class or individual by another", declares that its
first task is to put an end to the communist rule in
Russia, and urges peoples of that country to follow the
brilliant example set by Germany, where the ideas of
nationalism and patriotism have triumphed over the ideas
of marxism, communism and internationalism. Proclaiming
its absolute neutrality as far as inner and social
organization of Russia is concerned, the League, on the
strength of political and economic experience of the
recent past, is of the opinion that the principles of
various national-socialistic parties applied in accordance
with local conditions have proved most practicable and sound
and, therefore, recommends their adoption by the peoples
of Russia.

俄罗斯民族主义党（ROSNATI）俄罗斯分部

1933年下半年，一份题为《爱国者联盟告俄罗斯人民书》的俄文小册子在俄罗斯社区中流传，声称出自“国际爱国者联盟”，同时流传的还有另一份小册子，简要概述了“俄罗斯民族主义党”（Rosnati）的纲领，据称由该党在里加的“指导中心”出版。1934年期间，一系列四份由“俄罗斯民族主义党（Rosnati）远东分部”出版的“宣言”在上海流传。在这些宣言中，更详细地解释了该党纲领的各个要点。

《爱国者联盟告俄罗斯人民书》的内容以及该党的名称让人几乎毫无疑问地认为，该党发起者的活动是受纳粹在德国成功掌权的启发。该联盟的主要目的是“消除一个民族、阶级或个人对另一个民族、阶级或个人的剥削”，它宣布其首要任务是结束俄罗斯共产党的统治，并敦促该国人民效仿德国树立的光辉榜样，在那里，民族主义和爱国主义思想战胜了马克思主义、共产主义和国际主义思想。联盟宣称在俄罗斯的内部和社会组织方面保持绝对中立，并根据近期的政治和经济经验认为，各种国家社会主义政党的原则在适应当地条件的情况下已被证明是最可行和健全的，因此建议俄罗斯人民予以采纳。

It appears from the program of "ROSNazi" that
propagation of ideas of "pure nationalism" within the
U.S.S.R. as well as among Russian emigres with a view to
bringing about the overthrow of the communist rule in
Russia is the immediate task of the party. A period
of dictatorship will then follow pending the formation of
a National Assembly, which will have the prerogative of
determining the form of a national government. The
national government will be above all party and class
interests and will rule the country in accordance with
the people's will expressed through the medium of
professional corporations.

Declaration of the party dated August 26, 1934
contains an analysis of the political situation in the
Far East in connection with the possibility of an armed
conflict between the communist government of the U.S.S.R.
and the nationalist Japan. Rosnazi declare that a
co-operation of Russian nationalists with Japan in the
case of an intention on her part to seize Russian
territory is absolutely out of question. Further they
maintain that an annexation of a part of Russian territory
in the Far East as well as establishment of a buffer
state in that territory would be detrimental to the true
interests of Japan, which demand an expansion in the
southern direction. Should Japan in her conflict with
the U.S.S.R. pursue solely the aim of eliminating
communist influence in Asia, Russian nationalists can only
welcome the coming war between the two countries concerned,
as it will present a favourable situation for outbreak
of a national revolution in the U.S.S.R. Rosnazi hope
that Japan will adopt the latter course of action, in which
case they predict an era of peaceful co-operation of the
national Russia, Japan and China in Asia.

从“ROSNazi”（俄罗斯纳粹）的纲领来看，该党的当前任务是在苏联境内以及俄罗斯流亡者中传播“纯粹民族主义”思想，以期推翻俄罗斯的共产主义统治。随后将进入一个独裁时期，直至国民议会成立，该议会将拥有决定国家政府形式的特权。国家政府将超越一切党派和阶级利益，并通过职业团体的媒介，按照人民表达的意志来治理国家。

该党于1934年8月26日发表的宣言分析了远东的政治局势，特别是考虑到苏联共产党政府与民族主义日本之间发生武装冲突的可能性。Rosnazi宣称，如果日本有意夺取俄罗斯领土，俄罗斯民族主义者与日本的合作是绝对不可能的。此外，他们坚持认为，兼并远东部分俄罗斯领土以及在该地区建立缓冲国，将有损于日本的真正利益，因为日本的利益要求向南方扩张。如果日本在与苏联的冲突中仅仅以消除共产主义在亚洲的影响为目标，俄罗斯民族主义者只能欢迎这两个相关国家之间即将到来的战争，因为这将为苏联爆发民族革命提供有利局势。Rosnazi希望日本采取后一种行动方针，在这种情况下，他们预言亚洲将迎来民族主义的俄罗斯、日本和中国和平合作的时代。

referred to above show that neither the "Russian National
League of Patriots" nor the "Russian Nationalists Party
(Rosnazi)" exist in the Far East. Moreover, it is
very doubtful that such organizations exist at all. The
pamphlets in question were published in Shanghai by a
small group of Russian emigrants headed by I. P. Zaitseff,
formerly a General in the Russian army. The ideas
expressed in the program of "Rosnazi" present an interest
only insofar as they, to some extent, may reflect the
the feelings of Russian emigrants.
General I. P. Zaitseff, graduate of the Petrograd
Academy of the General Staff, served with distinction in
the ranks of the Russian Imperial army during the Great
War, and later during the civil war in Siberia was
attached to Ataman Dutoff's cossack troops. Following
the defeat of the "White" army in Siberia he arrived in
China and resided in Shanghai from March, 1921 till
April, 1923, when he left for Peking. He then applied
to the Soviet authorities for permission to return to
Russia and soon afterwards proceeded to that country.
After due publicity had been given by the Bolshevicks
to the story of a "repented" White General he was arrested
and tried for his past counter-revolutionary activities
and subsequently was sentenced to three years imprisonment.
In 1928, while en-route from one prison to another, he
succeeded in escaping from custody in Siberia and fled to
China. In May, 1929 he returned to Shanghai. In 1931
Zaitseff published in Shanghai a book entitled "SOLOVKI",
in which he related his experiences while in the U.S.S.R.
According to him, his decision to return to Russia was
dictated by purely patriotic motives, as he thought that
even under Bolshevist regime he would be able to serve
his country better than by remaining abroad. In this
he was bitterly disappointed. However, the sincerity
of his declarations was strongly suspected by his former

I. P. Zaitseff（音译）将军毕业于彼得格勒总参谋部学院，在大战期间于俄罗斯帝国军队中服役并表现杰出，后来在西伯利亚内战期间隶属于杜托夫（Dutoff）阿塔曼的哥萨克部队。随着西伯利亚“白军”的失败，他来到中国，并于1921年3月至1923年4月居住在上海，随后前往北平。此后，他向苏维埃当局申请返回俄罗斯的许可，并很快前往该国。在布尔什维克大肆宣传这位“悔过”的白军将军的故事后，他因过去的反革命活动被捕受审，随后被判处三年监禁。1928年，在从一所监狱转移到另一所监狱的途中，他在西伯利亚成功逃脱监管并逃往中国。1929年5月，他回到上海。1931年，Zaitseff（音译）在上海出版了一本名为《索洛韦茨基》（SOLOVKI）的书，讲述他在苏联的经历。据他说，他决定返回俄罗斯是出于纯粹的爱国动机，因为他认为即使在布尔什维克政权下，他也比留在国外能更好地为国家服务。在这方面，他感到极度失望。然而，他的声明的诚意受到了他前

RUSSIAN NAZIS
BANNED
Reich Concession to the
Soviet Government

Berlin, Sept. 28.
The political police here yesterday issued a decree prohibiting forever in Prussia the existence of the Russian National Socialist Association, and ordering its immediate dissolution.
The creation of a White Russian Nazi organisation patronised by Herr Alfred Rosenberg, Chancellor Hitler's right-hand man and chief of the Nazi Bureau of Foreign Affairs, was very unfavourably regarded by the Soviet Government. It is, therefore, believed that the dissolution of the association may be interpreted as a concession made by the Reich to Moscow.
The measures taken against the Soviet journalists at Leipzig, including their arrest, search and imprisonment, were directed against the Soviet Communist press, not against the Soviet Government, declares the semi-official "Political and Diplomatic Correspondence."—Havas.

RUSSIAN MONARCHIST PARTY OF LEGITIMISTS

The first attempt to organize Russian monarchists
in exile into one body took place in May 1921 when the
1st Monarchist Congress was convened in Reichenhall,
Bavaria, under the official name of the "Congress of
Economic Reconstruction of Russia." The congress
adopted the principles of the "Restoration of Monarchy
in Russia with the Legitimate Tsar from the Romanoff
Family." It was also decided that a member of the
Russian Imperial Family should be at the head of the
monarchist movement. In conformity with the above
decisions the "Supreme Monarchist Council," which was
elected at the congress, addressed a petition to this
effect to the late Empress Dowager and Grand Duke Nicolas
Nicolaevitch, as well as to Grand Duke Cyril Vladimirovitch.
The Empress replied that according to the fundamental
laws of the Russian Empire she could not be at the head
of the monarchist movement. Grand Duke Nicolas
Nicolaevitch expressed his readiness to lead the movement
on the condition that the Russian people calls upon him
to do so. Grand Duke Cyril Vladimirovitch in his reply
declared that as a senior member of the Romanoff family,
he had decided to exercise his prerogative and to fulfill
his duty in leading the Russian Monarchist movement. This
was followed by the rescript of July 8, 1922, in which
Grand Duke Cyril proclaimed himself the "Guardian of the
Russian Imperial Throne", pending the time when the
final proofs are available of the death of members of the
Romanoff family who were senior to him and had preference
as successors to the Throne. The declaration met with
the open opposition of the Supreme Monarchist Council
who were in favour of Grand Duke Nicolas Nicolaevitch as
leader of the Russian monarchist movement while leaving
the prerogative of the guardianship of the Russian
Imperial Throne to the Romanoff family as a whole.

正统派俄罗斯君主党

将流亡的俄罗斯君主主义者组织成一个统一团体的第一次尝试发生在1921年5月，当时第一届君主主义大会在巴伐利亚的赖兴哈尔（Reichenhall）召开，正式名称为“俄罗斯经济重建大会”。大会通过了“恢复俄罗斯君主制，拥立罗曼诺夫家族的正统沙皇”的原则。会议还决定，俄罗斯皇室成员应担任君主主义运动的领袖。根据上述决定，大会上选举产生的“最高君主主义委员会”向已故皇太后、尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇大公（Grand Duke Nicolas Nicolaevitch）以及基里尔·弗拉基米罗维奇大公（Grand Duke Cyril Vladimirovitch）提交了请愿书。皇后回复称，根据俄罗斯帝国的基本法律，她不能担任君主主义运动的领袖。尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇大公表示，如果俄罗斯人民呼吁他这样做，他愿意领导该运动。基里尔·弗拉基米罗维奇大公在回信中宣布，作为罗曼诺夫家族的资深成员，他决定行使自己的特权，履行领导俄罗斯君主主义运动的职责。随后是1922年7月8日的诏书，基里尔大公在诏书中自封为“俄罗斯帝国皇位守护者”，直到有确凿证据证明比他年长且拥有皇位继承优先权的罗曼诺夫家族成员死亡为止。这一声明遭到了最高君主主义委员会的公开反对，该委员会支持尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇大公作为俄罗斯君主主义运动的领袖，同时将俄罗斯帝国皇位守护者的特权留给整个罗曼诺夫家族。

page_data.en:
-2-
This was the origin of the first serious dissension
in the ranks of Russian monarchists in exile. The
dissension became wider after Grand Duke Cyril issued,
on August 31, 1924, a manifesto in which he declared that
in conformity with the laws of the Russian Empire defining
the order of succession to the Throne, he had decided
to assume the title of "Russian Emperor." The Empress
Dowager and Grand Duke Nicolas Nicolaevitch, supported
by the Supreme Monarchist Council, considered this act
as being premature and were opposed to it, which resulted
in the final split of the supporters of the monarchist
movement into two main factions. The followers of
Grand Duke Cyril - the Legitimate Monarch - have since
been known under the name of the "Legitimists."
Grand Duke Cyril's residence and the headquarters
of the legitimists are situated at St. Brias, France.
The so-called "Gosudarevo Soveshanie" (Tsar's Council)
which was established in November 1924 and which is a
part of the immediate entourage of the Grand Duke, directs
the activities of the branches of the Russian legitimists
established in various parts of the world. The activity
of each branch is, in turn, controlled by a local
representative of "His Imperial Majesty."
Ex-service men among the Legitimists are enrolled
in the "Imperial Navy and Army Officers' Corps." The
corps is divided into military-administrative areas which
are sub-divided into districts. Members of the corps
are regarded as being on active service and are subject
to a disciplinary code. In a similar manner, ex-civil
officers and persons possessing professional qualifications
are organized in the "Corps of Officers of Imperial
Civil Service."
The object of these organizations is - to keep
ready cadres of qualified military and civil personnel for
any time when their services may be required.
page_data.zh:
-2-
这就是流亡的俄罗斯君主主义者队伍中首次出现严重分歧的起因。1924年8月31日，基里尔大公（Grand Duke Cyril）发表宣言，宣称根据界定皇位继承顺序的俄罗斯帝国法律，他决定承袭“俄罗斯皇帝”头衔，此后这一分歧进一步扩大。皇太后和尼古拉·尼古拉耶维奇大公（Grand Duke Nicolas Nicolaevitch）在最高君主主义委员会的支持下，认为此举为时过早并予以反对，导致君主主义运动的支持者最终分裂为两大主要派系。基里尔大公——即“合法君主”——的追随者自此被称为“正统派”（Legitimists）。基里尔大公的寓所及正统派的总部设在法国圣布里亚克（St. Brias）。所谓于1924年11月成立的“戈苏达列沃·索韦沙尼耶”（Gosudarevo Soveshanie，即沙皇会议），作为大公核心幕僚的一部分，指导着在世界各地建立的俄罗斯正统派分支的活动。各分支的活动又由“陛下”的地方代表进行管控。正统派中的退役军人被编入“帝国海陆军军官团”。该团划分为若干军事行政区，区下再分设分区。团员被视为现役人员，须遵守纪律条例。同样地，前文职官员及拥有专业资格的人士也被组织进“帝国文官军官团”。这些组织的目的是——随时保持合格的军事和文职人员骨干队伍，以备需要其服务之时。

page_data.en:

In accordance with various local conditions the
membership in these bodies may be open or secret.
Members of Legitimist's Association are called
upon to contribute to the "Tsar's Fund," the contributions
being: (a) compulsory, consisting of 1% of individual
monthly earnings and (b) voluntary donations. A part
of the funds thus collected representing 25% of the
compulsory and 50% of the voluntary contributions is
remitted to the Grand Duke's Chancery at St. Briac to
finance the activity of the centre, while the remaining
sum is spent on the needs of local branches.
Guiding principles of the legitimist movement are
contained in manifestoes, rescripts, orders, instructions
and addresses issued by Grand Duke Cyril, as well as in
the literature and periodic publications issued by the
headquarters and various branches.
Propaganda of the ideas of the legitimist movement,
mutual moral and material aid, studying problems of the
political, military, cultural and economic organization
of the future Russian Empire; cultivating the religious
feeling and denouncing the true nature of the III
International - are some of the tasks indicated by the
Grand Duke Cyril in a circular letter to all his
representatives, dated August 10, 1924.
In the same letter Grand Duke Cyril clearly points
out that all local branches of the legitimists must not
be in any way connected with the political life of the
country in which they live; that they must occupy
themselves with purely Russian affairs only and maintain
absolute loyalty to the governments of the countries which
extended their hospitality to Russian emigrants.

political developments in the Far East, Grand Duke Cyril
defined the attitude of the legitimist movement as

"Any foreign intervention in the struggle against
the Soviet Government, any separatist tendencies and
agreements which are harmful to the interests of
Russia are to be rejected. Active help must be
extended to inner national elements of Russia which
endeavour to free the country from the communist rule
and to rebuild her former greatness and power.
"All combinations which may prove harmful to the
economic interests of Russia are to be rejected; any
financial obligations which in future may prove to
be detrimental to her national interests must be
declined no matter how attractive may be the prospects
of obtaining financial credits by means of these
combinations."
Maintaining that the monarchist form of
government is the only one which can lead Russia to a
great future the legitimists are far from advocating a
restoration of pre-revolutionary form of monarchy in
Russia. They take into consideration the important
changes which took place during the past 15 years in
in political, economic and social structure of the
modern Russia. Their conception of future Russia
is a combination of the best traditions of the Russia's
past with the revolutionary innovations which have
proved useful and which have been accepted by the masses.
Grand Duke Cyril's address to the Russian people and to
the Red Army and Navy, dated respectively December 24,
1931 and November 28, 1932 (Appendices A and B) contain
certain statements which are already significant enough
from this point of view, but the program of the so-called
"Union of Young Russians" (Mladorossy) -a branch of the
legitimist movement, is a most striking example of the
evolution of the Russian monarchist movement in this
direction.

Appendix "A"
Translation of extracts from Grand Duke Cyril
Vladimirovitch's address to the Russian People,
dated December 23, 1931, St. Briac, France.

THE EMPEROR'S ADDRESS TO THE RUSSIAN PEOPLE
------------------

"On the occasion of the New Year I extend my
congratulations to all Russians who believe in the
coming revival of their motherland in accordance with
the traditions of its great past combined with new
exigencies of life.

Another difficult year has passed bringing
disappointment to those who expected that the serious
economic crisis and general political unrest which
followed the world war, would be overcome during the
course of that year. A new year is coming. It will
inevitably lead all peoples to abandon of old conceptions
and the adoption of new social systems.

We are at the turning point between two epochs.
Capitalism has degenerated into a system of oppression
of the masses by an insignificant minority. People
have begun to realise this and a struggle against the
oppressors is developing. Does it mean that capitalism
will be saved by the various forms of police dictatorship
or that it will be replaced by communism?

Of course, it does not. We are passing through
a transition period and all state systems which originated
recently, are of a temporary character and only in the
course of time they can crystalise into some definite
concrete systems which will guide mankind to some new
organization and give them true freedom.

Russia was the first to be drawn into the terrible
whirlpool which destroyed the centuries' old foundations
of her state organization. Having passed through this
difficult period Russia will be regenerated and begin the
realization of her mission to the world - creation of a
new culture. Russia is on the way to a great future.

皇帝致俄罗斯人民文告
------------------

“值此新年之际，我向所有相信祖国必将复兴的俄罗斯人致以祝贺，这种复兴将依据其伟大过去的传统，并结合生活的新需求。

又一个艰难的年份过去了，那些期望世界大战后严重的经济危机和普遍的政治动荡能在该年内得到克服的人感到失望。新的一年即将到来。它必将促使所有民族放弃旧观念，采用新的社会制度。

我们正处于两个时代之间的转折点。资本主义已蜕变为少数 insignificant 多数人对大众的压迫体系。人们开始意识到这一点，反抗压迫者的斗争正在发展。这是否意味着资本主义将通过各种形式的警察独裁得以挽救，或者将被共产主义所取代？

俄罗斯是第一个被卷入摧毁其国家组织数世纪根基的可怕漩涡的国家。度过这段艰难时期后，俄罗斯将获得再生，并开始实现其对世界的使命——创造新文化。俄罗斯正迈向伟大的未来。

Appendix "B"
ROMANOFF APPEAL
Against Armed Intervention.
To the Editor of the "North-China Daily News."
Sir, - In your issue of today's date appeared a
very short trans-Ocean Kuo Min cable on Grand Duke Cyril's
message to the Red Army. As this cable does not give
the very patriotic tenure of H.I.H.'s message, I take
the liberty to quote below the cable of Havas regarding
the same appeal.
"Paris, January 3. An appeal was launched to
the Soviet Army by the Grand Duke Cyril, head of
the House of Romanoffs, who emigrated to France
after the Russian Revolution. "The national
conscience is becoming firmer in Russia." the Grand
Duke write in his manifesto "This shows that the
deliverance is near. The Army and Navy, which
are still called Red, are permeated with national
feeling and are the only Russian Forces capable
of saving the country from the Communist opposition
and disintegration. Russian soldiers, I am
appealing to you. Your might is a guarantee of
the invilability and security of the Russian state.
Your duty is to strengthen the power of the Army
and Navy, to exalt their spirit, to maintain the
discipline and to work on their technical perfectioning.
The time will come for the country to thank you,
after you have put an end to the communist despotism.
It will then be your duty to protect the unity of
the empire and the free development of the nations
of which it is composed." - Havas.
This patriotic appeal of the Head of the Romanoff
Dynasty is undoubtly part of a New Year Message to
the Russian people and shows how adverse is the
recognised head of all Russian loyal monarchists to
any project of armed intervention into Russian affairs.
Russian Shanghailander.
Shanghai, Jan. 6, 1933.

RUSSIAN GENERAL MILITARY UNION
(R.O.V.S.)

The Russian General Military Union was founded in
1921-22 by General Wrangel, Commander-in-Chief of the White
Russian Army in South Russia. General Wrangel's army was
forced to evacuate Russian territory in 1920 and was later
disbanded, the bulk of the men having since settled in either
Jugo-Slavia, Bulgaria or France. The object of the Union is
to effect unification of the members of various White Russian
armies dispersed in various parts of the world, and to maintain
the traditions of the old Russian army, as well as to enable
members to keep in touch with the progress of military science
and technique with a view of maintaining a cadre of the army
in an organized state ready for such a time as it may be
called for action. The organization is of a military
character and is governed as such, although the membership is
entirely optional.

In accordance with the principles of the old Russian
army the Union does not interfere with purely political matters,
except that it is openly opposed to the Communist Rule in
Russia. The Union, therefore, welcomes the co-operation of
all factions of Russian emigres which do not believe in the
possibility of a gradual evolution of the present regime in
Russia into a form corresponding to the wishes and interests
of the Russian people, but advocates the necessity of overthrow-
ing the Communist Rule in Russia by means of armed force.

It is believed that the Union has established
contact with certain elements in Soviet Russia dissatisfied
with the Communist regime with a view to securing mutual
understanding and co-operation, and what is still more
important, that it has its "cells" within the Red Army.

The Far Eastern Branch of the Union is generally
considered to be in a most favourable position for carrying
on the work within the Soviet Far East.

俄罗斯全军联盟
(R.O.V.S.)

俄罗斯全军联盟由南俄白俄军队总司令弗兰格尔将军（General Wrangel）于1921-22年间创立。弗兰格尔将军的军队于1920年被迫撤离俄罗斯领土，随后解散，大部分人员此后定居于南斯拉夫、保加利亚或法国。该联盟的宗旨是实现分散在世界各地的各支白俄军队成员的统一，维护旧俄军队的传统，并使成员能够随时了解军事科学和技术的进步，以便保持一支有组织的军队骨干队伍，随时准备在需要时投入行动。该组织具有军事性质并依此进行管理，尽管成员资格完全自愿。

根据旧俄军队的原则，联盟不干涉纯政治事务，但它公开反对俄罗斯的共产主义统治。因此，联盟欢迎那些不相信俄罗斯现政权能够逐渐演变为符合俄罗斯人民愿望和利益的形式、但主张必须通过武力推翻俄罗斯共产主义统治的各派俄罗斯流亡者的合作。

据信，该联盟已与苏维埃俄罗斯境内对共产主义政权不满的某些势力建立了联系，旨在达成相互理解与合作，更为重要的是，它在红军内部拥有其“细胞”组织。

普遍认为，该联盟的远东分部处于在苏维埃远东地区开展工作的最有利地位。

Being fully aware that the plans of Japan may in

日本为了实现其在满洲的计划并追求其政治和经济目标，已走上了一条不可避免地导致与苏联冲突的道路。这种冲突可能导致两国之间的战争，并可能在贝加尔湖以东的俄罗斯领土上建立一个“缓冲国”，该国由俄罗斯民族政府领导并在日本的保护之下，目的是使其属地不与苏联直接接触。

UNION OF MLADOROSSY

The origin of the Union of Mladorossy, a branch of
the Russian Monarchist Party of Legitimists, can be
traced back to 1923, when a conference was held in Munich
by representatives of various Russian nationalist groups
of post-revolutionary formation. In a declaration
issued by that conference it was definitely stated that
the idea of a restoration of the pre-revolutionary Russia
must be abandoned and that all thoughts of the national-
thinking Russian youth must be directed towards a new
Russia, for which new political and social-economic forms
had to be found. The conference also declared their
allegiance to the principles of Monarchism.

A certain A. L. Kasem-Beck, who at that time was only
22 years of age, was elected President of the conference
and under his leadership a group was founded under the
name of the "Group of Young Russia." For the follow-
ing eight years the activities of that group, which in
1925 adopted the name of the "Union of Mladorossy," was
devoted solely to the development of ideas expressed in
the declaration referred to above. In 1930-31 the
Mladorossy held a series of public meetings, lectures
and disputes in Paris, during the course of which they
announced and defended the basic principles of their
program. At the same time they started the publication
of a newspaper entitled "Mladorosskaya Iskra," which has
since become the central organ of the party.

Frowned upon by one part of Russian emigres on
account of their radical views and despised by the socialist
and democratic factions because of their allegiance to
Grand Duke Cyril, the Mladorossy, nevertheless, held their
ground and gradually developed into a fairly well organized
political party, which has attracted all politically active
elements within the Russian Monarchist Party of Legitimists.

青年俄罗斯联盟（MLADOROSSY）

青年俄罗斯联盟（Union of Mladorossy）是合法主义俄罗斯君主党（Russian Monarchist Party of Legitimists）的一个分支，其起源可追溯至1923年，当时各种后革命时期形成的俄罗斯民族主义团体的代表在慕尼黑举行了一次会议。在该次会议发表的宣言中，明确指出必须放弃恢复革命前俄罗斯的想法，所有具有民族意识的俄罗斯青年的思想必须指向一个新的俄罗斯，为此必须找到新的政治和社会经济形式。会议还声明效忠君主制原则。

当时年仅22岁的A. L. 卡塞姆-贝克（A. L. Kasem-Beck）当选为会议主席，在他的领导下，成立了一个名为“青年俄罗斯小组”的团体。在接下来的八年里，该团体（于1925年采用“青年俄罗斯联盟”之名）的活动完全致力于发展上述宣言中所表达的思想。1930-31年间，青年俄罗斯联盟在巴黎举行了一系列公开会议、讲座和辩论，在此期间，他们宣布并捍卫其纲领的基本原则。同时，他们开始出版一份名为《青年俄罗斯火花报》（Mladorosskaya Iskra）的报纸，该报此后成为该党的中央机关报。

青年俄罗斯联盟因其激进观点而受到一部分俄罗斯流亡者的冷眼，又因其效忠基里尔大公而受到社会主义和民主派别的蔑视，尽管如此，他们仍站稳了脚跟，并逐渐发展成为一个组织相当完善的政党，吸引了合法主义俄罗斯君主党内所有政治活跃分子。

and also attracted sympathies and support among the
younger generation of Russian emigres. At present
branches of the Union of Mladorossy exist in all
countries where Russian emigres reside, with the exception
of Germany and Poland, in which countries this party
is banned.
From the attached brief outline of the main points
of the program of the Mladorossy it will be seen that
it combines loyalty to the principles of Monarchism
with a very radical program of political and social-
economic structure of the state, which they define as
the "Social Monarchy" (Tsar and Free Soviets) and the
establishment of which, they hope, will follow the
"national revolution" (overthrow of the communist rule)
in Russia. Further, the Mladorossy believe that the
communist rule in Russia can be overthrown only from
within, by the Russians themselves, and are strongly
opposed to any form of foreign armed intervention.
They also declare their readiness to recognize any
national government in Russia, which will succeed the
communists, firmly believing that by a free propagation
of their ideas they will win the support of masses of
the new generation in that country.
The present activities of the Union of Mladorossy
include: a) theoretical development of ideas and program
of the movement, b) wide propaganda by means of the press,
c) establishment of contact with foreign political groups
pursuing similar aims, d) education of members and
preparation of a cadre of trained political workers and
e) study of modern Russia and establishment of contact
with the younger generation within Russia, who are
freeing themselves from the influence of the communist
doctrine.

并在年轻一代的俄国流亡者中也吸引了同情与支持。目前，除德国和波兰这两个禁止该党活动的国家外，在所有有俄国流亡者居住的国家均设有“青年俄罗斯联盟”（Union of Mladorossy）的分支机构。

从附上的关于“青年俄罗斯派”（Mladorossy）纲领要点的简要大纲中可以看出，该派将对君主制原则的忠诚与一种非常激进的国家政治和社会经济结构纲领相结合，他们将其定义为“社会君主制”（沙皇与自由苏维埃），并希望这种制度的建立将紧随俄罗斯的“民族革命”（推翻共产主义统治）之后。此外，“青年俄罗斯派”认为，俄罗斯的共产主义统治只能由俄罗斯人自己从内部推翻，并强烈反对任何形式的外国武装干涉。他们还声明，愿意承认俄罗斯任何接替共产主义者的民族政府，坚信通过自由传播其思想，他们将赢得该国新一代广大群众的支持。

“青年俄罗斯联盟”目前的活动包括：a) 对运动的理念和纲领进行理论发展，b) 通过报刊进行广泛宣传，c) 与追求类似目标的外国政治团体建立联系，d) 教育成员并培养一批受过训练的政治工作骨干，以及 e) 研究现代俄罗斯，并与俄罗斯境内正在摆脱共产主义教义影响的年轻一代建立联系。

The structure of the party, as well as its program
has many features common with the Fascist movement. No
elections are allowed within the party, all activities
of which are directed by A.L. Kasem-Beck, their leader,
and officers appointed by him. Strict discipline is
maintained. The Mladorossy describe their party as
an Order, members of which should be prepared to devote
their lives entirely to the national cause. Admission
into the party is not easy and is preceeded by a period
of probation (six months) and the passing of several
tests, after which they are called upon to swear that
they will be loyal to the party. The Mladorossy do
not pursue the aim of their increasing numerical strength
only, but endeavour to create a picked body of politically
educated and trained members, every one of whom could be
trusted with responsible tasks. They believe that a
party organized on such principles can assume the leader-
ship of masses when an opportunity presents itself.

The Directing Centre of the Union of Mladorossy is
in Paris. Branches of the Union in various countries
are controlled by Representatives of the Directing Centre,
who are appointed by the leader of the party. According
to their respective numerical strength the branches are
sub-divided into brigades, groups (eshags), cells and
pickets.

Within the legitimist faction the Mladorossy are
entirely independent. It is reported that Grand Duke
Cyril has endorsed their program and tactics and issued
a special order prohibiting any interference with their
activities on the part of the so-called "official legitimists"
who, on the whole, have proved to be a very inertial body.
They maintain friendly relations with the Russian General
Military Union, which they regard as a purely military
organization.

该党的组织结构及其纲领具有许多与法西斯运动共同的特征。党内不允许进行选举，所有活动均由其领袖 A.L. 卡塞姆-贝克（A.L. Kasem-Beck）及其任命的官员指导。维持严格的纪律。“青年俄罗斯派”将其政党描述为一个“骑士团”（Order），其成员应准备将整个生命奉献给民族事业。入党并非易事，需经过一段试用期（六个月）并通过几项测试，此后须宣誓效忠政党。“青年俄罗斯派”并不仅仅追求数量上的增长，而是致力于创建一个经过政治教育和训练的精英团体，其中每个人都可被委以重任。他们相信，按此原则组织的政党在机会出现时能够承担领导群众的任务。

“青年俄罗斯联盟”的指导中心位于巴黎。各国分支机构由指导中心的代表控制，这些代表由党魁任命。根据各自的人数规模，分支机构细分为旅、组（eshags）、小组和哨位。

在正统派系内部，“青年俄罗斯派”保持完全独立。据报道，基里尔大公（Grand Duke Cyril）已认可他们的纲领和策略，并发布特别命令，禁止所谓的“官方正统派”干涉他们的活动，后者总体上被证明是一个非常僵化保守的群体。他们与“俄罗斯将军军事联盟”（Russian General Military Union）保持友好关系，视其为纯粹的军事组织。

The first activities of the Mladorossy in Shanghai
refer to the earlier part of 1932 when a branch of the
Union was established in this city under the leadership
of V. A. Klarin. Several public meetings and
lectures were held for propagating their ideas and
publication of a weekly magazine entitled "Novy Put"
(New Road) was started. At first the Union made a
show of activity, which, however, gradually subsided
towards the end of 1932, when their organ ceased
publication owing to lack of funds.
Following the appointment in October 1933 of
Mr. N. A. Wilgelminin (ex-Naval officer, employed with
the Shanghai Power Company) to the post of Representative
of the Directing Centre of the Union of Mladorossy in
the Far East, the activities of the Shanghai branch of
the Mladorossy received a new stimulus. The publication
of the "Novy Put" was resumed in the form of a
fortnightly newspaper and regular work has since been
conducted by a small group of active members, with the
result that the present membership including the
"reserve" (sympathisers) is reported to be about 300.
The Union maintains a reading room at No. 724 Avenue
Foch, where regular meetings of groups of members and
candidates engaged in the study of various political
and economic subjects take place.
Similar groups are reported to have been established
in Tientsin and Harbin. The latter group headed by
an engineer named Delmatoff, has a special importance
insofar as through its medium the Mladorossy endeavour
to organize the transportation of their propaganda
literature into the USSR.

“青年俄罗斯派”在上海的最初活动可追溯至 1932 年初，当时在该市 V. A. 克拉林（V. A. Klarin）的领导下建立了联盟的一个分支。举行了多次公开会议和讲座以宣传其理念，并开始出版名为《新路》（Novy Put）的周刊。起初，联盟表现出活跃的姿态，然而到了 1932 年底，由于缺乏资金，其机关刊物停止出版，活动逐渐平息。

继 1933 年 10 月 N. A. 维尔格尔米宁先生（N. A. Wilgelminin，前海军军官，受雇于上海电力公司）被任命为“青年俄罗斯联盟”指导中心在远东的代表后，上海分支的活动获得了新的推动力。《新路》以双周报的形式恢复出版，自此由一小群活跃成员开展常规工作，据报目前的成员人数包括“后备人员”（同情者）在内约为 300 人。联盟在福煦路 724 号设有一间阅览室，成员和候选人群体定期在此集会，研习各种政治和经济课题。

据报道，天津和哈尔滨也建立了类似的团体。后者由一名名为德尔马托夫（Delmatoff）的工程师领导，具有特殊的重要性，因为“青年俄罗斯派”正试图通过该团体作为媒介，组织将其宣传文献运送进苏联。

Young Russians".

1. Born Tsar and Free Soviets. Centralised power
reconciliating and unifying, in the interests of the state,
all territorial, national and professional interests.

2. United Empire. Full autonomy for all provinces with Russian
as well as with non-Russian population. Freedom and right
of all peoples of the Empire to organize their inner life
in accordance with their cultural and national traditions.

3. Self-government of the people. Citizens participate in
the government of the state not by virtue of their being
members of some political party, but by virtue of their
cooperation in the creative activity of the people, spirit-
ual as well as material.

4. Social peace. Cooperation of all social classes of the
nation. Overcoming of class struggles by the abolition of
class division. Division by professions will take the
place of division by classes.

5. General reconciliation of the people. General political
amnesty. Abolition of political parties. Abandoning the
idea of restoration of social and property rights.

6. Freedom of conscience and religion. Guarantee of the
freedom of the inner life of the Orthodox Church. Questions
affecting the interests of both religion and state will be
decided by representatives of the parties concerned.

7. Revival of family. Creation of good economic conditions,
which will strengthen the family principle. Purification of
morals. Complete liquidation of the destructive principles
of communism.

8. Complete freedom of the peasantry. Abolition of forced
labour and of every interference in favour of any
particular form of cultivation of land. Final re-
distribution of land and securing the right of property

1. 天生沙皇与自由苏维埃。集中权力，为了国家利益，调和并统一所有领土、民族和职业利益。

2. 统一帝国。所有省份享有充分自治权，无论其人口是俄罗斯人还是非俄罗斯人。帝国所有民族均有自由和权利，根据其文化和民族传统组织其内部生活。

3. 人民自治。公民参与国家治理，并非因其属于某个政党，而是因其参与了人民在精神和物质方面的创造性活动。

4. 社会和平。全国所有社会阶层的合作。通过废除阶级划分来克服阶级斗争。职业划分将取代阶级划分。

5. 全民和解。全面政治赦免。废除政党。放弃恢复社会权利和财产权的想法。

6. 良心和宗教自由。保障东正教会内部生活的自由。涉及宗教和国家双方利益的问题，将由有关各方代表决定。

7. 家庭复兴。创造有利于加强家庭原则的良好经济条件。净化道德。彻底清除共产主义的破坏性原则。

8. 农民完全自由。废除强迫劳动以及对任何特定土地耕作形式的偏袒性干涉。最终重新分配土地，并确保耕种者的财产权

9. Freedom of labour. Freedom of toilers. Freedom of
private initiative. Demands of the inner market must be
satisfied, excessive export exhausting the people's
economy must be abandoned. Encouraging of commercial
cooperation. State's control over production. Struggle
against exploitation and profiteering. Development of
industry based on the prosperity of the peasantry.

10. Protection of labour. Mediation of the state in conflicts
between employers and workers. Workers participation in
the profits. Sanitary living conditions and guarantee
of pension for workers. Cooperation, under the control
of the state, of employers and workers.

11. Political education of the people. Education of large
masses by the combined efforts of the state, society and
private initiative. Stimulating of national feelings
and national pride.

12. Securing for Russia a position among other countries,
in accordance with her dignity. Realization of the
historic mission of Russia.
